title: Super fancy hotel
content: Hey everyone so last night I had a dream about super fancy hotel with red carpet and gold accents. It almost seemed like a fancy Asian hotel and the ceiling was like 100s of feet high. There was a parking garage in the middle of it and the floor was marble. There were women walking around with gowns and I was by myself, which they were confused why I was alone. They were super snobby and made me feel a certain way. There were hot tubs and showers in the lobby sort of hidden. There were large green exotic plants around. I sat down in the stadium seating that was in the lobby. The seats were red foldable chairs like in the movie theater. A 20 something year old girl wanted me to sit next to her and she began twisting my nipples. I felt super strange but then after she did I began twisting other girls nipples. I kept thinking I wanted to go back to my room but for some reason there was a vibe that if I did I wouldn’t be “cool”. Does this ring a bell for anyone?
